newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's SYCOM down due to power outage.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's SYCOM down due to power outage.

text.p: Australian futures trading has been delayed on Monday by a power outage at the Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE), a SFE spokesman said.
Due to a public holiday in Sydney, futures trading was being conducted on the computerised SYCOM after hours system.
However, the power outage had meant traders could not access the system, the spokesman said.
The SFE was working towards starting up their disaster recovery site, but could not give an estimated time of when the system would restart.
